title: Branched surfaces and triangulations — Question 7.8
exact_target: Does absence of sink disks ensure that a branched surface carries a lamination whose leafwise geodesic paths are recognized by a finite-state automaton?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10300022 (AMR-102-0022). CC BY 4.0.
